title: Not easy assembly
text:
Not easy assembly. It was a pain to assemble. Buy a drill because it was missing predrilled holes. I got it done but was not happy doing it.
Update- pick a spot and keep it there cause if you want to move this trash you might as well just toss it. It broke apart just moving it a few feet

product_metadata.title: Sauder Beginnings 5-Shelf Bookcase, Summer Oak finish
features: Three adjustable shelves for flexible storage options
Holds books, binders, framed photos, collectibles, and more
Detailed instruction book for easy assembly
Assembled Dimensions: L: 24.57" x W: 11.5" x H: 71.18"
description: Is storage an issue in your home? Look no further. We have the solution for you! This 5-shelf bookcase from the Beginnings® collection is just what you need. This large bookshelf features five spacious shelves that offer all the space you need to store items like stacks of books, work binders, and organizing bins. These spacious shelves also make a great place to display home décor items like decorative plants, knick-knacks, and photos of your family and friends. This tall bookcase includes three adjustable shelves that have the ability to move to different heights to create flexible storage options for items of all shapes and sizes. It has a place for all of your things! This five-shelf bookcase adds beautiful style and design to any room in your home – the living room, your office, or down the hallway. Finished in Summer Oak™, this beautiful display bookcase gives your home the look you want with the functionality that you need.
